hosting.//: One entry per path, repetitive on purpose. Sources must not overlap: a '**' rule alongside the '/delete-account' one wins over it whichever order they are in, which silently put the documents' script-less policy on the one page that runs scripts and broke it. Alternation ('@(/|/privacy|...)') was tried instead and matched nothing at all, so each path is listed on its own. The 404 page answers at any path, so it gets no entry — it carries no script and nothing to protect.
